WITH trades_propres AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
      WHERE mfe_pct IS NOT NULL 
        AND mae_pct IS NOT NULL 
        AND (mfe_pct != 0 OR mae_pct != 0)
    ) AS n_propres
  FROM trades_a
),
global_stats AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_trades,
    ROUND(AVG(mfe_pct), 4) AS avg_mfe,
    ROUND(AVG(mae_pct), 4) AS avg_mae,
    ROUND(AVG(pnl_pct), 4) AS avg_pnl_pct
  FROM trades_a
  WHERE mfe_pct IS NOT NULL
),
long_short AS (
  SELECT
    direction,
    COUNT(*) AS total_trades,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pnl_pct > 0) AS gagnants,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pnl_pct < 0) AS perdants,
    ROUND(AVG(pnl_pct), 4) AS avg_pnl_pct
  FROM trades_a
  WHERE mfe_pct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY direction
),
per_hour AS (
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(HOUR FROM entry_time) AS heure,
    COUNT(*) AS total_trades,
    ROUND(AVG(pnl_pct), 4) AS avg_pnl_pct
  FROM trades_a
  WHERE mfe_pct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY heure
)
SELECT
  'progression' AS section,
  tp.n_propres AS trades_propres,
  30 - tp.n_propres AS trades_restants,
  ROUND(tp.n_propres * 100.0 / 30, 2) AS progression_pct,
  NULL::text AS extra
FROM trades_propres tp

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'global_stats' AS section,

  NULL,
  'avg_mfe=' || gs.avg_mfe || ', avg_mae=' || gs.avg_mae || ', avg_pnl_pct=' || gs.avg_pnl_pct
FROM global_stats gs

  'long_short_' || ls.direction AS section,
  ls.total_trades,
  ls.gagnants,
  ls.perdants,
  'avg_pnl_pct=' || ls.avg_pnl_pct
FROM long_short ls

UNION ALL
